test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In February 2023, who joined as the new Chief Executive Officer of NITI Aayog?
solution:
The correct answer is __**BVR Subrahmanyam.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **B.V.R. Subrahmanyam:-**

 
 
• He is an Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer of the 1987 batch (Chhattisgarh cadre).
 
• **He is currently the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of NITI Aayog, the Government of India's policy think tank.**
 
• He has also served as the Secretary in the Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Chief Secretary of Jammu & Kashmir, and Additional Chief Secretary (Home) of Chhattisgarh.
 
• He has also served in various positions in the Prime Minister's Office. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **T. V. Somanathan:-**

 
 
• **He is a distinguished Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer of the 1987 batch, currently serving as the Finance Secretary of India. **
 
• He holds a PhD in Economics from the University of Calcutta and has extensive experience in various facets of public administration, finance, and development economics. 
 
 
 
• **Amitabh Kant:-**
 
 
• **He is an Indian economist, bureaucrat, and author who has served in various positions in the Government of India. **
 
• He is currently the G20 Sherpa of India, responsible for representing India at the G20 summits.
 
 
 
• **Ajay Kumar Bhalla:-**
 
 
• **He is an Indian civil servant who is currently serving as the Home Secretary of India. **
 
• He is a 1984-batch IAS officer of the Assam-Meghalaya cadre. He has held several important positions in the Government of India, including Secretary, Ministry of Power, Director General of Foreign Trade, and Additional Secretary, Department of Commerce.
